configurations.name: matchlens-backend-check
runtimeArgs: cd backend && MATCHLENS_LLM=offline MATCHLENS_CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3002 uv run uvicorn matchlens.api.app:app --port 8767

configurations.name: matchlens-frontend-check
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && npx next build && MATCHLENS_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8767 npx next start --port 3002

configurations.name: broadcast-label
runtimeArgs: cd backend && uv run --group vision python -m matchlens.vision.label
